items.title: Luca Guadagnino Is 'Not Afraid' of Sam Altman Backlash to 'Artificial'
items.excerpt: Guadagnino says he is not afraid of backlash over 'Artificial', his film dramatizing OpenAI and Sam Altman, arguing people with power over AI must be aware of their responsibility.

items.title: 'Light Pillar' Director Xu Zao Readies AI-Themed Follow-Up 'Easy, My Friend'
items.excerpt: The Berlinale animation director's HAF Film Lab project follows an illustrator who rebuilds her life after AI takes her drawing skills and job; Xu calls AI a change of tool, not of filmmaking's core.

items.title: Tripo AI's Yanpei Cao Talks SmartMesh, Open Source and Previs
items.excerpt: Tripo AI's chief scientist, fresh off a SIGGRAPH Real-Time Live! Best in Show, explains how its generative 3D tools (SmartMesh) help artists with reference, blockouts and previs.

items.title: LightBox Founders On Taking A Hard Line Against Generative AI: 'We Think Generative AI Is Theft And It's Not Real Art'
items.excerpt: LightBox Expo co-founders Bobby Chiu and Jim Demonakos explain why the animation/concept-art expo bans generative AI and how studios recruiting there responded.

items.title: MForMedia & Arcana Labs Sign AI Production Pact For Middle East
items.excerpt: Dubai's MForMedia will integrate Arcana Labs' AI production workflows into its film and TV slate under a new regional pact.

items.title: BBC Boss Matt Brittin Says He Was Sent A 'Doctor Who' Episode Entirely Generated By AI
items.excerpt: BBC director-general Matt Brittin says he watched an unofficial, fully AI-generated 'Doctor Who' episode and found it 'pretty good', raising IP and craft questions for broadcasters.

items.title: Amazon's Kelly Day Says AI Will Unlock 'Creative Risk' & Help Creatives On The Next 'Fleabag'
items.excerpt: Prime Video's international chief argues AI tools will lower costs of experimentation and free creatives to take risks, saying it amplifies rather than replaces imagination.

items.title: Can Art House Theaters Use AI-Driven Data Models to Reach a More Targeted Audience?
items.excerpt: The 'Inside the Arthouse' podcast partnered with data company Chronicle to test AI-driven audience models for marketing independent films to art-house moviegoers.

items.excerpt: Rich Young's monthly roundup of After Effects 26.5 (IBC release), AI features and AI-assistant beta, freemium competitors and third-party plugin news for motion designers.

items.title: AI Sound Design Is Here... But Is It Any Good?
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge tests the latest AI sound-design tools across multiple workflows to see how they affect film and video post-production.

items.title: How Much of Filmmaking Can AI Agents Actually Do?
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge lets an AI agent (GPT Astra) organize and edit a video, including VFX, SFX and marketing assets, and reports what worked and what didn't.

items.title: How to Create a Depth Map Using AI + FREE Tool Download
items.excerpt: Tutorial on generating depth maps from footage with a free AI tool that runs locally on Mac or via Fal.ai, for compositing and relighting workflows.

items.title: What Mattered to Hollywood at This Year's Iberseries & Platino Industria
items.excerpt: Wrap of Madrid's Iberseries & Platino Industria, where AI in production was among the hot-button debates alongside microdramas and Spanish-language co-productions.

items.title: Mubi's Efe Cakarel: 'We are going to stay as far away from AI as possible when it comes to films'
items.excerpt: Mubi uses AI in engineering and operations but will keep it away from films, Cakarel said at the Zurich Summit, betting that human taste and provenance gain value as AI content floods in.
